# Perth’s leading prestige property and project-marketing agencies

For luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses and architecturally distinctive residences in Perth, I’d separate the market into two groups: **specialist development sales and project-marketing firms**, which help developers launch and sell a project, and **prestige residential agencies**, which excel at presenting and selling individual high-end properties.

Based on current agency portfolios, stated specialisations and available industry recognition, these are the firms I would put on a serious shortlist. This is a qualitative assessment, not a definitive ranking of every Perth agency.

## 1\. Leading agencies to shortlist

![Forbes Residences — MJA Studio](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/z8BmFNi7kzl-PVdmJ6T0BUPyd40gyJPmahtJzsEBOZ0SXe12ooRvqNUv72JLoLADyv46CPbr32kMdZSce8Rhw-KkHjKM0GnzRIGcPekpxnRwevMhkJSjQWSAXsBBEnAkOG3xjWU9N4RPjcShGM-6RR0H-aQCkEuQFbBGMrdEtN4L-QbVAMwzA8yc4JHq1uon?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Jones Realty & Projects

(Best overall for development marketing)

**Best for\:** Premium off-the-plan apartments, penthouses, townhouses and architect-led residential projects.

Jones combines feasibility advice, pricing, buyer research, branding, marketing and sales through to settlement. Its published portfolio includes Manhattan Applecross, a high-value apartment development. Its website also cites major industry awards for project sales and marketing in 2025–26. ## 2\. Realestate 88

(Best for inner-city apartments and penthouses)

**Best for\:** Luxury penthouses, premium apartments and new residential projects in central Perth.

Realestate 88 explicitly markets itself across the apartment spectrum, including luxury penthouses, and highlights its history of selling new apartment developments with major WA developers. It is a particularly relevant candidate when the product is apartment-led rather than a traditional prestige house. **Best for\:** End-to-end developer support and larger residential project campaigns.

**Best for\:** Apartment and strata-focused developments where technical sales expertise matters.

KPR specialises in apartment, townhouse and strata sales. Its project-marketing lead, Tony Beamish, is described by the firm as having experience spanning more than 25 WA developments over three decades, from early project stages through to sell-out. This makes KPR a strong candidate for developments where buyers need detailed guidance on strata, levies and ownership structures. ## 6\. ZSA ZSA Property

(Best for architectural character)

**Best for\:** Architect-designed homes, design-led residences and distinctive luxury property.

ZSA ZSA is a boutique agency with a design-conscious positioning. It is a strong comparison for projects where architectural identity, visual storytelling and a carefully curated buyer audience are as important as broad lead generation. I would assess its fit for a multi-residence off-the-plan development separately from its fit for a one-off architectural property. ## 2\. Prestige agencies for individual luxury properties

These are additional firms I would approach when the priority is a premium buyer pool, international reach or a high-value architectural residence rather than a large off-the-plan sales programme.

![Perth’s most famous socialite puts mansion on the market](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Uo3hfYJ3BiCKfMchBqzpwEQB9WdzPLu0HLHUef2OtYjzmJo9-8ENSBAynU8HdRWYW_Rl6qxYm9KPf7pORH5azWGYs8rcfyKdQ_La2I63damrYPZl_u4kHVWPfqz13BuIfLggFuqEBJhsn0BLBVTFFK3c0yJ8Lpiy_4IbsGtR_73vBVm9Kn4SFm6MqWu0tU0J?purpose=fullsize)

**William Porteous Properties International**

An established prestige agency with experience marketing high-value homes and developments, particularly across Perth's western suburbs and premium lifestyle locations. Its published profile highlights international buyer relationships and transactions extending into the \$50 million-plus range. Worth considering for trophy penthouses and exceptional residences. Its local affiliate connects Perth listings to a global luxury real estate network. I would shortlist it for exceptional penthouses and architectural residences aimed at affluent domestic and overseas buyers. **Western Australia Sotheby's International Realty**

A luxury-branded option for premium homes and residences that may benefit from international marketing distribution and a high-end client network. Compare its specific Perth agent's experience with penthouses and new developments before appointing it for a project-wide campaign. [Agency information](https://www.sothebysrealty.com/)

## 3\. Which agencies lead each segment?

| Property or project type | My first agencies to approach |
|--------|--------|
| Luxury off-the-plan apartment development | Jones Realty & Projects, PRD Perth |
| Premium penthouses and inner-city apartments | Realestate 88, KPR Perth |
| Large-scale or multi-stage development | Jones Realty & Projects, PRD Perth, House Business Group |
| Architect-designed, one-off luxury residences | ZSA ZSA Property, William Porteous Properties International |
| Trophy property with international buyer appeal | Christie's International Real Estate, William Porteous Properties International |
| Strata-heavy apartment development | KPR Perth, Realestate 88 |


The distinction matters: an agency with excellent prestige-home sales may not have the buyer database, presales infrastructure or reporting systems to sell 30–100 apartments off the plan.

## 4\. What I would verify before appointing a project marketer

For a genuinely premium development, ask each shortlisted agency for\:

- **Comparable projects\:** Recently marketed Perth penthouses or architect-led developments, including achieved prices and time to sell.
- **Presale performance\:** Number of contracts exchanged before construction completion, cancellation rates and settlement outcomes.
- **Buyer reach\:** Evidence of access to high-net-worth local, interstate and international buyers.
- **Brand execution\:** Examples of architectural photography, CGI, project brochures, display suites and launch events.
- **Commercial terms\:** Commission, marketing budget, exclusivity, campaign duration and the reporting provided to the developer.

Also distinguish between the agency's own marketing claims and independently verified awards or transaction results. Historical REIWA project-marketing tables are useful context, but older rankings should not be treated as a current league table. [reiwa.com.au](https://reiwa.com.au/uploadedfiles/public/content/find_an_agent/sales_awards_pdfs/top%20office%20residential%20project%20marketing%281%29.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[reiwa.com.au](https://reiwa.com.au/uploadedfiles/members/content/members/awards/top%20office%20residential%20project%20marketing.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were building a shortlist for a premium Perth development today, I would start with **Jones Realty & Projects, Realestate 88 and PRD Perth** for project sales capability, then invite **William Porteous Properties International and Christie's International Real Estate** to demonstrate their fit for the prestige buyer segment. Add **ZSA ZSA Property** if architectural identity and design-led positioning are central to the project.

One question would help me narrow this down: **Are you looking to appoint an agency to market a development as the developer, or identify the best agencies to sell an individual luxury penthouse or architectural property?** The strongest candidates differ depending on which side of the transaction you're on.

The distinction matters: an agency with excellent prestige-home sales may not have the buyer database, presales infrastructure or reporting systems to sell 30–100 apartments off the plan.

## 4\. What I would verify before appointing a project marketer

For a genuinely premium development, ask each shortlisted agency for\:

- **Comparable projects\:** Recently marketed Perth penthouses or architect-led developments, including achieved prices and time to sell.
- **Presale performance\:** Number of contracts exchanged before construction completion, cancellation rates and settlement outcomes.
- **Buyer reach\:** Evidence of access to high-net-worth local, interstate and international buyers.
- **Brand execution\:** Examples of architectural photography, CGI, project brochures, display suites and launch events.
- **Commercial terms\:** Commission, marketing budget, exclusivity, campaign duration and the reporting provided to the developer.

Also distinguish between the agency's own marketing claims and independently verified awards or transaction results. Historical REIWA project-marketing tables are useful context, but older rankings should not be treated as a current league table. [reiwa.com.au](https://reiwa.com.au/uploadedfiles/public/content/find_an_agent/sales_awards_pdfs/top%20office%20residential%20project%20marketing%281%29.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[reiwa.com.au](https://reiwa.com.au/uploadedfiles/members/content/members/awards/top%20office%20residential%20project%20marketing.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were building a shortlist for a premium Perth development today, I would start with **Jones Realty & Projects, Realestate 88 and PRD Perth** for project sales capability, then invite **William Porteous Properties International and Christie's International Real Estate** to demonstrate their fit for the prestige buyer segment. Add **ZSA ZSA Property** if architectural identity and design-led positioning are central to the project.

One question would help me narrow this down: **Are you looking to appoint an agency to market a development as the developer, or identify the best agencies to sell an individual luxury penthouse or architectural property?** The strongest candidates differ depending on which side of the transaction you're on.
